title: Roast Trout with Beetroot, Caraway Potatoes & Horseradish Yogurt
description: One-tray dinner: caraway-roasted beetroot and potatoes, trout baked on top for the last 10 minutes, with a sharp horseradish-dill yogurt.

ingredients.name: Waxy potatoes, cut into 3 cm chunks
Raw beetroot, peeled, cut into 2 cm wedges

steps.title: Prep the tray
steps.text: Heat the oven to 220 °C (200 °C fan). Toss the potatoes and beetroot with 1.5 tbsp olive oil, the caraway and 1 tsp salt. Spread on a large lined tray, keeping the beetroot to one side so it doesn't stain the potatoes.

steps.title: Roast the vegetables
steps.text: Roast for 40 min, turning everything once at the 20-min mark, until the potatoes are golden and a knife slides easily into the beetroot.

steps.title: Make the horseradish yogurt
steps.text: While the veg roast, mix the yogurt with the horseradish, the zest of half the lemon, 1 tbsp lemon juice, half the dill (chopped) and a pinch of salt. Chill until serving.

steps.title: Bake the trout
steps.text: Pat the trout dry, brush with the remaining ½ tbsp olive oil and season with the remaining ½ tsp salt and pepper. Nestle the fillets skin-side down between the vegetables and bake 8–10 min until the flesh flakes and is opaque all the way through.

steps.title: Plate and split
steps.text: Matthias: ≈360 g trout, about three-quarters of the potatoes and 60% of the beetroot, plus ≈120 g of the horseradish yogurt. Partner: ≈240 g trout, the remaining veg and ≈50 g yogurt. Finish with the rest of the dill and lemon wedges.

notes: Matthias's bigger share of horseradish yogurt is the protein bridge. If trout is out of stock, hake fillets bake in the same time (add 50 g more potatoes to Matthias's plate).
